# call

abstract suspend fun [call](call.html)(invocationContext: [InvocationContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-invocation-context/index.html)): [CallbackChoice](../-callback-choice/index.html)<[Unit](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unit/index.html), [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html)>

Callback executed before the ADK runner runs.

This is the first callback called in the lifecycle, ideal for global setup or initialization tasks.

#### Return

A [CallbackChoice](../-callback-choice/index.html) where returning [CallbackChoice.Break](../-callback-choice/-break/index.html) with custom [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html) halts execution of the runner and resolves the invocation with that content directly. Returning [CallbackChoice.Continue](../-callback-choice/-continue/index.html) with [Unit](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unit/index.html) allows execution to proceed normally.

#### Parameters

 _invocation Context_

The context for the entire invocation, containing session information, the root agent, etc.
